tiles.title: Security Events Timeline
tiles.query:
SecurityLogs
| summarize EventCount = count() by bin(Timestamp, 1m), EventType
| render timechart

tiles.title: Events by Person
tiles.query:
SecurityLogs
| summarize EventCount = count() by PersonID
| render barchart

tiles.title: Events by Location
tiles.query:
SecurityLogs
| summarize EventCount = count() by LocationID
| render piechart

tiles.title: Suspicious Events
tiles.query:
SecurityLogs
| where EventType has 'suspicious' or EventType has 'alert'
| project Timestamp, PersonID, LocationID, EventType
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 50

tiles.title: Communications Timeline
tiles.query:
Communications
| summarize MsgCount = count() by bin(Timestamp, 1m), CommsType
| render timechart

tiles.title: Communication Network
tiles.query:
Communications
| summarize MessageCount = count() by Sender, Recipient
| order by MessageCount desc

tiles.title: Message Status
tiles.query:
Communications
| summarize Count = count() by Status
| render barchart

tiles.title: Recent Messages
tiles.query:
Communications
| project Timestamp, Sender, Recipient, CommsType, Subject, Status
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 50

tiles.title: Audience Votes
tiles.query:
Votes
| summarize VoteCount = count() by Suspect
| order by VoteCount desc
| render barchart

tiles.title: Average Confidence by Suspect
tiles.query:
Votes
| summarize AvgConfidence = avg(Confidence), VoteCount = count() by Suspect
| order by VoteCount desc
| render barchart

tiles.title: Recent Audience Guesses
tiles.query:
Votes
| project Timestamp, Suspect, Confidence, Motive
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 25
